legal.draftNotice: Initial draft for demonstration. Needs legal counsel review before launch; items in [ ] are to be completed.

s1.p: SALEEM is an advisory tool that helps creators review content before publishing against an illustrative rulebook. It never grants an official approval or license.

s2.p: You are responsible for the decision to publish, the accuracy of the details you enter, and your right to upload the content.

s3.p: Don't upload unlawful content or other people's content without permission, or try to access other users' data.

s4.p: The service is subject to monthly plan limits. [Pricing and payment details to be added].

s5.p: The service is provided as is. We don't guarantee content is free of violations after a check. [Final wording by legal counsel].

s6.p: These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. [Jurisdiction to be specified].

s1.p: [Legal entity name, address and CR number]. Data enquiries: [data protection officer email].

s2.p: Account data (name, email, optional Mawthooq license number), the content you upload, and check results.

s3.p: We process data to provide the checking service, based on your consent and the contract, under the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).

s4.p: Video, frames and audio are deleted automatically 24 hours after a check. Findings and the file hash are kept while your account exists.

s5.h: Processors and transfers outside the Kingdom
s5.p: We use a database hosting provider and an AI model provider to analyze content; processing may occur outside the Kingdom. [List of processors, processing locations and safeguards].

s6.p: We don't sell your data or share it with any regulator or advertiser, and we don't use your content to train models.

s7.p: You can access, correct, port and delete your data. Download your data or delete your account directly from Settings.

s8.p: [Request channel, response time, and right to lodge a complaint with the competent authority].

s1.p: SALEEM results are advisory alerts, not an official approval from any government body. The final decision is yours.

s2.p: The rulebook was drafted for illustration from public sources and is pending legal review.

s3.p: The system may miss violations or flag acceptable content. Review the findings yourself and consult a specialist when needed.

s1.p: Timed speech transcript, one frame per second (up to 60), on-screen text, the caption and post details.

s2.p: Fixed automatic rules catch disclosures, discount codes and explicit claims; a vision language model understands context. We merge both and remove duplicates.

s3.p: Weak-evidence findings are shown as warnings, not violations; subjective rules (privacy, wealth display, attire) are always warnings.

s4.p: We measure per-rule hits, misses, false alarms and timestamp error on a Saudi-dialect test set. Current results come from a small set and don't cover every case.

s5.p: Transcription can confuse similar words or struggle with noise, and the model can misjudge age or context. We never identify people.

s6.p: Every report records the model, prompt version and rulebook version, and each compliance log is sealed with a publicly verifiable fingerprint.

desc.owner: Owns the workspace: every permission including granting and transferring ownership; never decides on their own upload.
desc.admin: Manages members (except the owner role), settings, products, features and partners; assigns reviewers; reviews and decides what they did not upload.
desc.compliance_lead: Leads compliance: assigns and reassigns reviews, manages rule packs and company rules, reviews and decides what they did not upload.
desc.reviewer: Reviews and decides only the cases assigned to them; never assigns, never decides their own upload, never edits marketing content.
desc.legal: Sees only the cases escalated to them (or answered by them) and gives legal opinions; never approves or browses other ads.
desc.creator: Creates ads and sees their own, answers findings, submits, uploads revisions and uses SALEEM Fix; never approves.
desc.external_uploader: External partner: submits through approved links and sees only their own ads; no internal members or data; never approves.
desc.external_reviewer: Reserved role: currently grants no access to organisation ads (external sharing is not enabled yet).
desc.viewer: Reads the workspace ads, records and analytics for audit; never writes, edits or approves.

cond.own_ad: Only on an ad they own or whose version they uploaded.
cond.decider: Not the uploader of the version; a reviewer only on cases assigned to them.
cond.self_approval: The uploader within an active rule, with no open violations, evidence requests, multi-stage flow or financial promotion.
cond.own_ad_fix: Only on an ad they own, with the feature on and quota left.
cond.readers_only: Only people who can see the ad; legal only on its cases.
cond.not_author: Not the author of the claim.

rules2.notRegulatory: These are your organisation's internal policies, not Saudi regulatory requirements. Their findings carry an «Internal policy» label, and no rule (including AI-extracted ones) becomes active until someone other than its author approves it.
rules2.extractFailed: The document text could not be extracted. You can paste the text manually.
rules2.guidelineTitlePh: e.g. Visual identity guide 2026 or Financial disclosure policy
rules2.guidelineTextPh: Paste the policy text or mandatory conditions here...
rules2.noMatch: No company rules match the search and filters.
rules2.instructionPh: Describe exactly what to check in the advertisement (logo, colours, terms, discount rates, mandatory disclosure)...

tile.legalOpen: Escalated to me, awaiting my opinion

dash3.fixHint: On an ad with requested changes, SALEEM Fix proposes a correction plan with revised text and video to review.
dash3.externalReviewerBody: The external reviewer role currently grants no access; only ads explicitly shared with you will appear here once sharing is enabled.

fix2.title: Video correction
fix2.subtitle: Edits are proposed from the findings and the corrected script. Review them, then render the corrected video; the original file is never changed.
fix2.subtitles: Subtitles with the corrected script ({n} segments)
fix2.scriptToRead: Corrected script to read in the voiceover:

voice.recorded: Record your own voice in the browser — available, free.
voice.uploaded: Upload a pre-recorded voiceover — available, free.
voice.gemini_tts: Gemini TTS: needs an API key with billing and SALEEM_FIX_TTS_PROVIDER on the server; not configured.
voice.heygen: HeyGen: needs an API plan (not the website or ChatGPT plugin subscription) and a server key; not configured.
voice.elevenlabs: ElevenLabs: needs an API account and a server key; not configured.

video.veo: Replacement video with Veo (Gemini API): paid, needs billing; not configured.
video.heygen_video: Avatar video with the HeyGen API: needs an API plan; not configured.
video.runway: Runway API: needs an account and key; not configured.

fix2.renderNote: Rendering happens on your device while the video plays once (about its length). The video is not sent to any provider.
fix2.rendered: Corrected video ready. Compare it with the original before accepting.
fix2.acceptVideo: Accepting uploads the corrected video as a new video version of the same advertisement and starts its analysis. The original stays and no approval carries over.
fix2.acceptVideoCta: Accept corrected video as a new version

err.generic: The video could not be rendered.
err.no_edits: No edits: the original video would not be offered as a corrected one.
err.recorder_unsupported: Your browser cannot record video (MediaRecorder). Use a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
err.source_unreadable: The original video could not be read (link expired or file deleted).
err.render_empty: The rendered file is empty; try again.

partner3.title: Organisations you are authorised for
partner3.body: Only organisations that added you as a partner or external reviewer appear here. Internal organisation data and other partners' advertisements are never shown.
partner3.unnamed: Organisation (name not available to your role)
partner3.noLinks: No submission link has been assigned to you yet. Ask the organisation to assign one.

footer.tagline: A workspace to prepare, check, correct, review and approve advertisements before publishing, for marketing and compliance teams in Saudi Arabia.
footer.notice: SALEEM is an assistive tool, not a regulator. It holds no endorsement from any official body and does not guarantee legal compliance. Automated results are advisory; final decisions belong to authorised people in your organisation.

hero.title: From idea to an advertisement ready for review and approval.
hero.body: An intelligent workspace that helps marketing and compliance teams create, check and correct advertising content, and manage review and approval before publishing.
hero.note: AI analysis is advisory, and the decision always belongs to an authorised person. SALEEM does not guarantee legal compliance.
hero.stageLabel: Animated walkthrough of the fictional Nada Cream ad, from detection to review
hero.v2Result: No automated violations · 2 warnings need evidence
hero.reviewerNote: Checks the contract and Mawthooq licence before deciding

facts.arabic: Arabic understanding of video, audio and text
facts.versions: Versions and comparison for every edit

journeys.title: Start from an idea, or from a finished ad.
journeys.body: Both paths end in the same place: a checked advertisement, with clear evidence, awaiting an authorised person's decision.

create.title: Create your ad with AI
create.lead: Bring product information, campaign goals, audience and brand requirements together, then prepare the content and check it before review.

steps.product: Product information from the product library
steps.script: Draft ad script from your brief

create.note: Generating script, voice and video from a brief is not enabled yet and needs external providers. Available today: product, campaign and brand rules set-up, writing the ad, checking it and submitting it for review.

check.title: Check and correct your ad
check.lead: Upload a video, image or text, see what was detected with evidence and timing, then correct, compare and submit for review.

steps.upload: Upload the ad: video, image or text
steps.evidence: Evidence and timestamp for each finding

ba.title: Nada Cream: what changed between the two versions?
ba.body: A cosmetics ad for a fictional product. Play both versions, then see how the automated findings changed and what still needs evidence or human verification.
ba.summary: {groups} consolidated findings from {raw} pieces of evidence
ba.note: A finding that is no longer detected is not a legal clearance of the ad. The two versions were analysed with different models; this is an illustration, not an accuracy benchmark. Version 2 was prepared manually for the demonstration.

how.title: The life of an advertisement, step by step.
how.body: Pick a stage to see what happens and who is responsible. AI assists; authorised people decide.

start.title: Create or upload the ad
start.body: Choose the product, campaign and channels, then upload a video, image or text. SALEEM checks the information is complete before starting.

analyse.title: Analyse the content
analyse.body: Transcribes Arabic speech, reads on-screen text and the caption, and selects the applicable rules by sector, communication type and publisher.

risks.title: Identify potential risks
risks.body: Every finding is tied to a specific rule and a clear classification: potential violation, warning, missing information or document requirement.

evidence.title: Evidence and correction
evidence.body: Jump from a finding to its second in the video, with the evidence, the reason and a suggested correction. Repeats of the same claim are consolidated.

correct.title: Correct the ad
correct.body: Edit the text and caption, or use the SALEEM Fix video editor: mute a segment, cover text, add a visible disclosure, subtitles, a recorded voiceover.

compare.title: Compare and re-check
compare.body: Every edit is a new version analysed from scratch, compared by video, text and findings. No earlier approval carries over.

submit.title: Submit for review
submit.body: Respond to each finding; the ad is assigned to an authorised reviewer, who can consult the legal advisor.

decide.title: Decision and record
decide.body: Approve, approve with conditions, request changes or reject, with reasons. Every decision is sealed in a record that cannot be edited.

cap.title: Built for Arabic advertising in a regulated setting.
cap.body: Connected capabilities from the first second of the video to the last decision in the record.

analysis.title: AI advertisement analysis
analysis.body: Reads video, audio, text, caption and publication context together, and applies only the rules that apply, explaining why others were excluded.

arabic.title: Arabic video and audio understanding
arabic.body: Arabic speech transcription timed per sentence, and reading of on-screen text.

evidence.title: Timestamped evidence
evidence.body: Every finding takes you to its second in the video, with the quoted evidence and its source.

fix.title: SALEEM Fix
fix.body: A correction plan per finding and an editable revised text before it is accepted as a new version.

media.title: In-browser video correction
media.body: Mute statements, cover text, add a visible disclosure, subtitles and a recorded or uploaded voiceover — without sending the video to any provider.

compare.title: Version comparison
compare.body: Video side by side, text sentence by sentence, and findings: what disappeared, what stayed, what is new.

rules.title: Regulatory and company rules
rules.body: A rulebook with sources, plus your brand's internal rules approved by a second person and shown as internal policy, not as regulation.

approvals.title: Human approval workflows
approvals.body: Reviewer assignment, approval levels and separation between who uploads and who approves.

conditional.title: Conditional approval
conditional.body: Specific conditions with required evidence, fulfilled by marketing and verified by the reviewer before final approval.

agencies.title: Agency collaboration
agencies.body: Submission links scoped by product, channel and limits; partners see only their own ads.

audit.title: Complete audit trail
audit.body: Who did what, when, on which version — with sealed decisions.

org.title: Organisation management
org.body: Nine roles, campaigns, products and permissions enforced by the server.

collab.title: Everyone knows their role and next step.
collab.body: The ad moves between teams along a clear path. SALEEM suggests and explains; only authorised people decide.

partner.title: External partner
partner.body: Submits ads through a dedicated link and sees only their own.

marketer.title: Marketing specialist
marketer.body: Prepares the ad, responds to findings, corrects and submits.

reviewer.title: Compliance reviewer
reviewer.body: Assesses findings and decides: approve, conditions or changes.

legal.title: Legal advisor
legal.body: Consulted on escalated cases and sees only that case.

admin.title: Organisation administrator
admin.body: Manages the team, roles, assignment and governance settings.

collab.flowLabel: How an ad moves through the organisation

trust.title: Trust built on evidence, not promises.
trust.body: SALEEM is clear about what it knows and what it doesn't, and leaves the decision with whoever owns it.

evidence.title: Evidence-based findings
evidence.body: Each finding has a quote, a timestamp and its source in the ad.

references.title: Rule references
references.body: Every rule with its source and legal-review status.

human.title: Human review
human.body: No automatic approval; an authorised person decides, with recorded reasons.

versions.title: Version history
versions.body: Every edit is a new version; the original is kept.

isolation.title: Organisation isolation
isolation.body: Each organisation's data is isolated at the database level.

roles.title: Role-based permissions
roles.body: Enforced by the server on every request, not just the interface.

accountability.title: Decision accountability
accountability.body: Decisions sealed in a chain that cannot be edited.

limits.title: AI limitations
limits.body: It can be wrong or miss things; partial coverage is shown clearly.

trust.regulatory: SALEEM's regulatory guide contains published rules and other draft rules still under legal review, which are not applied until approved. SALEEM is not an official body and does not represent any regulator.

final.title: Try SALEEM on your next advertisement.
final.body: Check an ad, explore the interactive example, or enter the available demo with demo accounts.

demo.explore: Explore the original ad and its findings, then the correction tools, the comparison between versions and the human review path. Everything here is static demonstration data.

lead.original: Play the original ad and pick any finding to jump to its moment in the video and highlight the related sentence.
lead.findings: Each consolidated finding: what was detected, where, why, the rule reference and the proposed correction.
lead.correct: What SALEEM Fix can change, applied to this example.
lead.compare: Both versions side by side: video, speech, caption and findings.
lead.review: How the ad enters review, who decides and what is still required.

demo.pick: Pick a finding to jump to its moment in the video.
demo.sourceNote: The reference as listed in SALEEM's rulebook; the official source text is subject to legal review.

req.COM-01: Remove the claim or provide documented scientific evidence for it.
req.MAW-01: A clear ad disclosure at the start of the clip and in the caption.
req.MAW-03: Attach the written agreement with the advertiser.
req.MAW-04: Manual check of the Mawthooq licence where it applies to the publisher.
req.AI-01: Disclose the use of AI in creating the content.

text.title: Text and caption correction
text.body: A proposed replacement for each finding, editable before acceptance.

overlay.title: Visible on-video disclosure
overlay.body: A «paid ad» band burnt into the frames themselves.

subtitles.title: Subtitles with the corrected script
subtitles.body: Written lines synchronised with the new speech.

cover.title: Cover problematic text
cover.body: Hide an on-screen statement for a set duration.

mute.title: Mute problematic statements
mute.body: Silence the original audio for the selected seconds.

voice.title: Corrected voiceover
voice.body: Record in the browser or upload a file. Automatic voice generation needs a provider that is not enabled.

demo.honesty: Version 2 in this example was prepared manually for the demonstration; SALEEM did not generate it automatically. The tools above are available in SALEEM Fix inside the workspace and produce a new version that is analysed from scratch.
demo.overlayFrame: First second of version 2: «paid ad» and «AI-generated content» disclosures
demo.claimFrame: Second 11 of version 1: «guaranteed result within 3 days» on screen
demo.openBody: The written contract and the Mawthooq licence are document requirements that text edits cannot resolve; the reviewer checks them before final approval.
demo.readOnly: Read-only page: no uploads, comments, decisions or AI requests from here.
